title: Death Prophecy
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji found the rift in the prophecy, but the fragments of the complete Tianji Record are scattered across the world—he must retrieve them all before the arrival of Chapter Seven Hundred.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure gradually faded before Chen Ji's eyes, turning into a wisp of blue smoke that sank back into the first page of the Tianji Record. The black and white pieces on the chessboard stopped rotating, and the Tianqing Sect Council Hall fell into dead silence. Chen Ji stood in place, his fingertips gently caressing the yellowed page, his heart surging with indescribable turbulent waves. The chess player— so he was merely a piece in a larger chess game, and the master of this game was none other than the all-transcending Heavenly Eye.

"Since you chose to face the truth..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice drifted from the depths of the book page, carrying an indistinguishable tone of either compassion or warning. "Prepare yourself for the consequences. In Chapter Seven Hundred, the gears of fate will fully engage. At that time, the core will of the Heavenly Eye will descend personally—not an avatar, not a projection, but a thread of divine consciousness from its true form." Chen Ji's eyes closed, and he inhaled deeply. He'd anticipated this day would come, yet never imagined it would arrive so swiftly.

"I want to see it." Chen Ji's eyes opened, his voice unexpectedly composed. "The complete prophecy, all of it. I need to know, under the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, just how spectacular my death will be." The moment the words fell, Chen Ji suddenly poured all the Heavenly Fate Value within his body into the Tianji Record fragment. Mo Xiansheng's exclamation was completely ignored—he didn't want to be protectively shown just the tip of the iceberg, but to face the entire glacier in its entirety. Heavenly Fate Value burned furiously, five points, ten points, twenty points...

Heaven swirled and earth spun. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being dragged into an endless abyss by an irresistible force. All around was boundless void, no light, no sound, no coordinates to rely on. Then, a massive eye opened in the void—the eye was composed of countless overlapping rings of light, each ring a layer of heavenly law, each layer of law speaking of an irrefutable heavenly fate. Terror surged like a tide, and Chen Ji nearly collapsed under that gaze.

But he gritted his teeth, staring fixedly at that eye. In the depths of the pupil, images began to emerge—those were the scenes of Chapter Seven Hundred, the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate wide open, the banners of three major sects fluttering in the wind. Chen Ji saw himself standing atop the mountain peak, clothes billowing, alone facing the black vortex descending from the crack in the heavens. Within the vortex, the core will of the Heavenly Eye slowly emerged, a cold voice resonating through heaven and earth: "An ant dared to peer into heavenly secrets, today shall be your great calamity."

dialogue.content: "Do you think you can rewrite fate?" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried no emotion, yet carried more pressure than any roar. "From the moment you obtained the Tianji Record fragment, the ending was already destined. All prophets are my pieces, and you are no exception. In Chapter Seven Hundred, I will personally erase your heavenly fate, letting you watch yourself turn to nothingness in despair."

text.content: The prophetic images shifted. Chen Ji saw himself channeling all his power, seventy-two acupoints burning simultaneously, Heavenly Fate Value turning into a torrential flood within his body. He saw himself deploying a trump card never shown before the world—that was a forbidden technique beyond his realm, the final strike traded with his life. However, the Heavenly Eye merely gently rotated its pupil, and all attacks dissolved like bubbles. Chen Ji's body began to fracture from the edges, piece by piece turning to ash...

Heavenly Fate at zero. Power at zero. Everything, under the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, all returned to zero. This was the ultimate meaning of the Death Prophecy—not simple death, but complete erasure. As if he had never existed at all. Chen Ji abruptly woke, gasping for breath, cold sweat drenching his body. Heavenly Fate Value had consumed a full fifty points, his face as pale as paper, but the light in his eyes burned more intensely than ever.

"Did you see it?" Mo Xiansheng's voice came from within the book pages. "This is the power of the Heavenly Eye. Before it, any resistance is futile. The battle of Chapter Seven Hundred, the ending is already written—you will die without fail." Chen Ji did not answer. He closed his eyes, replaying every detail he had just witnessed in his mind. Death Prophecy, inevitable ending, the power to erase everything... Yet, within the depths of that desperate vision, he saw something amiss.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, pupils blazing with sharp light. "Something's wrong. There's a temporal paradox in the prophecy." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment. "...What did you discover?" Chen Ji pointed to the moment of his death in the prophecy, his voice slightly trembling yet exceptionally firm. "Look here—at the instant the Heavenly Eye erased me, there was a full 0.3 seconds of stagnation. In that moment, time and space were frozen, my existence and non-existence coexisted. This is the flaw."

choice.prompt: The 0.3-second stagnation in the Death Prophecy—that was the only chance for survival. However, to seize this possibility, he needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Burn all remaining Heavenly Fate Value, proactively accelerate the triggering of the prophecy, challenge the Heavenly Eye in an incomplete state, attempting to trade time differential for survival.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all remaining Heavenly Fate Value, trigger irreversible karmic backlash
choices.visible_reward: Gain ten minutes of first-move advantage, complete the layout before the Heavenly Eye descends
choices.risk_hint: Success rate less than three tenths, and failure will directly trigger the death scene in the prophecy

text.content: Chen Ji forced all remaining Heavenly Fate Value in his body to his fingertips, transforming it into a brilliant light that sank into the Tianji Record. In an instant, images of ten minutes later appeared before his eyes—the descent of the Heavenly Eye would be advanced, and by then, the reinforcements from the three major sects had not yet arrived. He had only ten minutes to change all this.

choices.description: Make no preparations, directly enter Chapter Seven Hundred in current state, seek and utilize the 0.3-second temporal paradox in combat.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all preparation time, expose his discovery to the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will completely break the absoluteness of the prophecy, gain the possibility of defying heaven and changing fate
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may have already detected your discovery, the temporal paradox may have already been repaired

text.content: A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He chose not to flee, nor to wait. Since the Heavenly Eye gave him the chance to see the flaw, it meant this flaw was permitted to exist—or that even it could not eliminate. Either way, it was worth gambling his life on.

choices.description: Conservative strategy: utilizing the time difference in the prophecy, secretly search for other fragments of the Tianji Record before Chapter 700 arrives, attempting to complete the Tianji Record to enhance the possibility of confronting the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes significant time, during which resistance from other forces may be encountered
choices.visible_reward: Each fragment obtained increases the completeness of the prophecy, raising the odds of confronting the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may trigger the prophecy in advance before you find the fragments

text.content: Chen Ji slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air. Impulse is the privilege of the weak, and he never lacked patience. The 0.3-second time paradox requires sufficient power to support it, otherwise even if caught, it cannot be held firmly. He needs fragments, needs a more complete Tianji Record. And before that, he must make everyone believe he has resigned himself to fate.

choices.memory_label: 陈机发现时间悖论，决定寻找碎片增强实力

text.content: After making his decision, Chen Ji instead became completely calm. He sat cross-legged in the center of the Council Hall, with the Tianji Record spread open on his lap. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered in the pages, seemingly awaiting his decision. "Mo Xiansheng," Chen Ji suddenly spoke, "you said all previous prophets were pawns of the Heavenly Eye. Among them, was there anyone who ever broke this ending?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long time, long enough that Chen Ji thought he would not answer. Then, that remnant soul gently sighed: "There was one. His name was Chen Xuan." Chen Ji's heart suddenly leaped - that was his ancestor, the original owner of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng continued: "He found another path. Not direct confrontation, but... going around it."

text.content: "Go around it?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. "How?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly spoke: "Chen Xuan did not choose to directly confront the Heavenly Eye in Chapter 700. He chose an earlier point in time - Chapter 547, to change an event that seemed inconsequential. That event caused a deviation in the Heavenly Eye's tracking of him. In the end... he vanished in the river of time, neither erased nor truly escaped."

Chen Ji fell into deep thought. Chen Xuan's choice gave him new inspiration - not necessarily having to directly clash with the Heavenly Eye, one could avoid the prophecy by changing other nodes on the timeline. But this also meant he would have to abandon many advantages already established and relayout. More importantly, changing past events might affect many people, including... Chen Nian. Thinking of his missing sister, Chen Ji's eyes darkened.

choice.prompt: The legacy left by Chen Xuan is thought-provoking - but changing the past means sacrificing the present. Chen Ji needs to make a choice.

choices.description: Following the clues left by Chen Xuan, go to where the Chapter 547 event occurred, attempt to replicate his unfinished method, and fundamentally evade the Heavenly Eye's pursuit.
choices.visible_cost: Need to abandon all current layouts, act under an assumed identity
choices.visible_reward: May obtain the complete Tianji Record core pages left by Chen Xuan
choices.risk_hint: Chapter 547 event involves the Ancient Forbidden Land, danger level unknown

text.content: Chen Ji stood up and tucked the Tianji Record into his chest. He made his decision - rather than clashing with the Heavenly Eye in the open, he would, like Chen Xuan, find breakthroughs from the shadows. Only this time, he would do it more thoroughly.

choices.memory_label: 陈机决定追寻陈玄的足迹

choices.description: Not following Chen Xuan's old path, but insisting on one's own plan, directly confronting the Heavenly Eye in Chapter 700, creating a miracle with that 0.3-second time paradox.
choices.visible_cost: Odds of success extremely low, may cause those around to perish together
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will completely break free from the Heavenly Eye's control and become a true free person
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's power far exceeds imagination, the 0.3-second window may just be bait

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, a trace of determination flickering in his eyes. He was not Chen Xuan, unwilling to escape like a rat. The path he chose was to prove, before everyone, under the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, that fate is not invincible. Even if he fails, he will make the Heavenly Eye pay the price.

choices.memory_label: 陈机决定正面对抗天道之眼

text.content: Just then, hurried footsteps came from outside the Council Hall. Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the door, her face rarely showing a hint of anxiety: "Chen Ji, something happened. Elder Ling Yuan suddenly announced the early convening of the Sect Competition, and... he specifically named you to participate." Chen Ji's eyes moved slightly. Ling Yuan, that old fox who had always hidden in the shadows - was he finally going to make his move?

"What else did he say?" Chen Ji's voice was very calm, as if what was coming was not a crisis, but a chess game he had long anticipated. Su Qingyao hesitated, then lowered her voice: "He said... he wants to publicly reveal the secrets of the Tianji Record at the Sect Competition, before everyone." Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constricted. Ling Yuan was going to completely expose him, forcing him into a deadly ground.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of mockery and coldness: 'The old fox can finally sit still no longer. Publicly revealing the secrets of the Tianji Record? Does he think this will force me to submit?' He stood up, gazing at Tianqing Sect Main Peak outside the window, his voice low and dangerous, 'Since he wants to play, then I'll accompany him. Only, I wonder if he's prepared to bear the consequences when the truth is revealed.'

text.content: Su Qingyao watched Chen Ji's retreating figure, an indescribable emotion surging in her heart. This person who had once been ridiculed by everyone in the Sect, when had he grown into an existence that even made her feel a chill in her heart? She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but ultimately it only turned into a single word: 'Be careful.' Chen Ji didn't look back, merely nodding slightly. Outside the Council Hall, the sky darkened and the winds changed—a new round of the chess game had just begun.

Night fell, and Chen Ji stood alone at the peak of Tianqing Sect Main Peak, overlooking the flickering lights of the Sect below. The Tianji Record in his arms grew slightly warm, as if sensing the turmoil in his master's heart. The complete vision of the death prophecy remained vivid in his mind, and the pressure of the Heavenly Eye still seemed to linger at his heart. But Chen Ji felt no fear—he had never been someone who would be intimidated by fate. The 0.3-second time paradox, that was his breakthrough point. And now, he was going to make Ling Yuan the first stepping stone.
